# Support

## Reporting a bug

Open an [issue](https://github.com/A-Frantyk/mdreader/issues) with your OS,
the app version (Menu → About mdreader), and steps to reproduce. If it's a
rendering issue, attaching the `.md` file (or a minimal snippet) that
triggers it helps a lot.

## What's out of scope

mdreader is desktop-only (Windows, Linux, macOS) — there is no iOS/Android
build and none is planned. See the project's `CLAUDE.md` for why.

## Funding

mdreader is free and MIT-licensed. If it's useful to you, voluntary support
is welcome — see the [README's Support section](https://github.com/A-Frantyk/mdreader#support)
for details:

- [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?business=ifrantya%40gmail.com) — one-time or recurring
- [monobank jar](https://send.monobank.ua/jar/9jmpz3bVHs) — for supporters in Ukraine

Support has no effect on the app itself — no paid tier, no feature gating, ever.
